description: This file declares the interface for the Content Filtering HTTP Session Management Object, including functions for creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization.

methods.name: CfFmmoComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates a component of the Content Filtering HTTP Session Management object.

methods.name: CfFmmoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Content Filtering HTTP Session Management object.

methods.name: CfFmmoRemove
methods.description: Removes an instance of the Content Filtering HTTP Session Management object.

methods.name: CfFmmoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects for the Content Filtering HTTP Session Management object.

methods.name: CfFmmoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Content Filtering HTTP Session Management object.
